Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring state employees to be truthful when providing employment-related information.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to requiring that a state employee be truthful whenproviding information; adding a new section to chapter 42.52 RCW; andprescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 42.52 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) State employees shall be truthful and forthright when providinginformation or answering questions related to the scope of theiremployment, the performance of their duties, and the operations of theagency at which the state employee is employed. (2) State employees shall be truthful when providing information ofany kind. (3) A violation of this section is subject to disciplinary actionunder RCW 42.52.520.
